changes: Synchronizes current Nous Research upstream through PRs #376 and #378 while preserving Muncho's fork-local execution authority.
Keeps canonical workspace and recovery behavior intact across the synchronized CLI, gateway, desktop, cron, delegation, and terminal paths.
Preserves prompt caching, strict message-role alternation, and structural delivery outcomes while retiring authored-text classifiers.
Makes SkyAI/Codex profile-local provider credentials shadow optional global auth before filesystem I/O.
Preserves missing-profile fallback to readable global auth and whole-pool fallback when a profile has no local provider credentials.
known_limitations: SkyAI receives the profile-auth fix only after its separate controlled rollout of the released exact source; a Muncho deploy alone does not change SkyAI.
This release does not repair or activate the separately blocked upstream-sync timer successor rebind.
notes.rollback_note: Rollback restores exact v2.3.5 at 6b19f8edf5062f01659e352f55f8c671080ffdea; immutable release artifacts remain audit evidence.
